story: You are a researcher at Mount Sinai Hospital, analyzing patient data from the past five years to understand the factors influencing hospital admissions and treatments. You are collecting detailed information on each patient's demographics, medical history, and treatment outcomes to identify patterns and improve patient care.

variables.name: PatientID
variables.desc: Unique identifier for each patient

variables.name: Diagnosis
variables.desc: Primary diagnosis of the patient

variables.name: TreatmentStatus
variables.desc: Whether the patient received treatment

variables.name: AgeGroup
variables.desc: Age group of the patient

variables.name: GlucoseLevel
variables.desc: Glucose level in mg/dL

variables.name: BloodPressure
variables.desc: Blood pressure reading in mmHg

variables.name: MedicationType
variables.desc: Type of medication prescribed

variables.name: MealSize
variables.desc: Amount of food consumed by the patient

variables.name: SeverityLevel
variables.desc: Severity of the patient's condition

variables.name: Gender
variables.desc: Gender of the patient

variables.name: AdmissionSource
variables.desc: How the patient was admitted to the hospital

variables.name: SurgicalProcedure
variables.desc: Whether and which surgical procedure was performed

variables.name: SmokingStatus
variables.desc: The patient's smoking status

variables.name: AllergyType
variables.desc: Any known allergies the patient has

variables.name: InsuranceType
variables.desc: The type of insurance the patient has

variables.name: DischargeDisposition
variables.desc: Where the patient was discharged from the hospital

variables.name: Comorbidity
variables.desc: Any pre-existing comorbid conditions the patient has

variables.name: VisitReason
variables.desc: The primary reason for the patient's visit to the hospital

variables.name: BedType
variables.desc: The type of bed the patient occupied during their stay

variables.name: MedicationRoute
variables.desc: The route by which medications were administered

questions.question: Which variables causally affect 'VisitReason' in this network?
Once we know the value of 'AdmissionSource', are 'GlucoseLevel' and 'AllergyType' statistically independent?
Even after accounting for 'MealSize', are 'AgeGroup' and 'BloodPressure' statistically dependent?
